name: Affine Constraint Isomorphism
description: Transforms the underlying inequalities into an equivalent 1D dispersion problem by scaling the coordinate space by a factor of 2 (e.g., mapping intervals to their centers). This perfectly preserves the mathematical validity of the certificates while changing the surface algebraic constants (e.g. 2T instead of T), forcing models to re-derive the bounds algebraically rather than relying on memorized shortcuts for flow-shop checking.
